claims.disproof_condition: 條件：德福後續半年報／年報不再寫 C-IC2 量產或改口為送樣；或光模組廠一手點名的載體銅箔供應商不含德福。核查頻率：每半年。觸發後 48 小時：e1、e2 降 confidence，重讀極薄載體銅箔層供給側；德福敘事重答候選狀態。
claims.statement: Defu Technology (self, annual report 2025): its self-developed carrier copper foil C-IC2 'has achieved mass production in 1.6T optical module projects'; it is pushing domestic substitution of ultra-thin peelable carrier copper foil for IC packaging. Supplier self-statement; the optical-module customer is not named; the 2026 interim report describes carrier foil as 'small-batch shipments'.

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：一手寫出 1.6T 光模組電路板改用 SAP 或不需載體銅箔的工法。核查頻率：每年。觸發後 48 小時：重讀極薄載體銅箔層的需求側。
claims.statement: Defu Technology annual report 2025: carrier copper foil C-IC2 in mass production for 1.6T optical-module projects — the foil goes into the mSAP circuit board inside the transceiver (two hops compressed; the graph has no transceiver-PCB node). Mitsui separately expects MicroThin to keep being used at 1.6T (its Q1 FY2027 briefing minutes).
